Controller edits / agent access
|-- MappingDocumentController manages domain state
|   |-- private snapshot; context; pendingNodeIds; listeners; nodeCache
|   |   `-- Opens a history context and retains its runtime handle.
|   |-- nodes(); configureLayout(cell, viewport); configureEndpointBounds(bounds)
|   |   `-- Read projections use current state; measured geometry can be refreshed.
|   `-- updateCanvas(value, record = false); select(command); commitDocument(document)
|       `-- Recorded changes append history; transient updates can bypass it.
|-- Shared edit boundary
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations); transact(expectedVersion, operations)
|   |   `-- Rejects stale versions and stages 1-100 operations on a cloned snapshot.
|   |-- prepareDiagramEdit(document, diagramId, edit)
|   |   `-- Calls diagrams.revise using the current staged diagram revision.
|   |-- patchDiagram / replace / setSourceMappings / setJumps
|   |   `-- Patch correspondence rebases edges, jumps, folds and section lines.
|   |-- diagram-create / diagram-insert / diagram-revision-apply
|   |   `-- Revision application checks the expected base before receiving content.
|   |-- move / collapse / group / remove / delete-diagrams
|   |   `-- Grid edits use cell layout; floating edits use display helpers.
|   `-- edge-create / edge-update / edge-remove
|       `-- Validate edge identity and anchors before document publication.
|-- Snapshot publication
|   |-- private updateSnapshot(next, record, increment = true)
|   |   |-- Reconciles connections, normalizes views and resolves floating geometry.
|   |   `-- historyService.append(context, document, canvas, pendingNodeIds)
|   `-- Replaces the snapshot, increments when requested and notifies listeners.
`-- Agent transport and page dispatch
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge(descriptor, handle, workspace?)
    |   |-- Owns an AbortController, retry timer and bounded reply cache.
    |   `-- Registers the canvas, polls commands and calls the latest handler.
    |-- handleAgentCommand(command)
    |   |-- context / document-state / snapshot: controller reads
    |   |-- apply: controller.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
    |   `-- Mutation receipts deduplicate retries; context reads stay fresh.
    |-- apply-diagram-revision: revisionReceiver.apply(..., controller, flushCallback)
    |   `-- The callback syncs workspace persistence and awaits storage.flush().
    `-- Cleanup aborts polling, clears retries and unregisters the canvas.
        `-- Calls publishLiveCanvasSelections with workspace and returns its cleanup.
